user.title: Connect Narwal Cloud
user.description: Enter the access and refresh tokens from the Narwal app. Both fields are stored securely in Home Assistant and are never included in this integration's source or logs. [How to obtain tokens]({token_guide_url})

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to Narwal Cloud. Check the tokens and try again.
error.no_devices: No Narwal robot is linked to this account.
error.invalid_response: Narwal Cloud returned incomplete device information.

abort.already_configured: This Narwal robot is already configured.
